title: How Do We Find Exoplanets? The Transit Method | Space Atlas
description: Most known exoplanets have never been directly photographed. See how astronomers detect a planet by watching its star's brightness dip as it passes in front.
ogTitle: How Do We Find Exoplanets? The Transit Method
ogDescription: Drag a planet across a star and watch the brightness dip that's how most exoplanets are actually found.
jsonldName: How Do We Find Exoplanets? The Transit Method
jsonldDescription: An interactive simulation of the exoplanet transit detection method, showing a star's brightness curve dipping as an orbiting planet passes in front of it.
